_about: Voice commands for one language (R5 §4.10 stage 7, S-11). Phrases match case-insensitively as whole words. newLine, newParagraph and scratchThat fire only at a clause edge on both sides (start or end of the text, a line break or clause punctuation), so 'a new line of credit' stays text; punctuation fires when nothing but punctuation or the end follows and the word before is not a blocker ('a question mark.' stays text). In scripts without spaces only the right edge is checked. A literal prefix right before any phrase keeps the phrase as words. Loaded by fork/text/commands.rs; tested there.
